descriptions.w3d_f13c_preview_properties_8026b6cc: Disables vector mode, retains the chosen preview name, uppercases a copy to recognize the .TGA suffix, substitutes the temporary-mission resource when required, disables the control, obtains border thickness, reduces the three-float preview size, detaches/releases and resolves the preview child, sets its size and parent, and for image resources performs lookup with an error message and fallback resource. Native string, held-interface and scoped-key lifetimes follow original instructions; field roles are inferred.
